short_description: Construction composition/failure/recovery semantics over the accepted T1A.7 runtime recovery, interest and selective-scale foundation.
purpose: Make multi-fixture Construction failure and recovery explicit in canonical runtime state without creating a second aggregate, persistence path, authority registry or network correctness layer.
expected_outcome: Runtime subjects expose deterministic ONLINE/DEGRADED/OFFLINE failure semantics, dependency failures propagate in bounded deterministic ways, failed commands have explicit policy, and checkpoint/reconnect recovery converges through the existing T1A.7 path.
